purpose: Fixed, arm-agnostic template that renders a modulation OPTION around a FIXED dictionary anchor. Same template for every arm; only the field phrases differ (supplied by arm construction). Denotation is never altered.

rater_facing_item_layout.prompt: Given the dictionary meaning and context above, which option better modulates or brings out the inner tendency/field of this word WITHOUT changing its meaning?
rater_facing_item_layout.option_A: <rendered template with field phrases from arm 1>
rater_facing_item_layout.option_B: <rendered template with field phrases from arm 2>

option_template: Within its fixed meaning, {word} carries a tendency toward {f1}, {f2}, and {f3}, giving the concept a tone of {f4}.

template_constraints.no_new_denotation: field phrases describe modulation/tone only; may not restate or redefine the dictionary meaning
template_constraints.no_symbolu_varna_vritti_markers: no varṇa names, Sanskrit terms, pole labels, or 'binding/liberating' wording visible to raters
template_constraints.no_arm_identifying_vocabulary: field phrases drawn from a shared surface register; no arm may use systematically richer/rarer adjectives

field_phrase_source: arm construction spec provides the 4 field phrases per (word, arm); the template is identical
style_audit_hook: after rendering, run the style-tell audit on options across arms; if the real arm is identifiable by surface style above threshold, STOP (do not proceed to human rating)
